name: overnight
description: Write a plan during the day, hand it off at bedtime, and wake up to committed, independently verified work on a dedicated branch.

default_stop_at.title: Default stop time
default_stop_at.description: Local wall-clock time the run must end by, as HH:MM. A plan's own setting overrides this.

default_model.title: Default model for workers
default_model.description: Model alias used for overnight worker sessions (opus, sonnet, haiku).

default_task_timeout_minutes.title: Per-task timeout (minutes)
default_task_timeout_minutes.description: Hard wall-clock kill for a single task attempt.
